mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_command_idempotency ( idempotency_id, caller_scope, operation_type, idempotency_key, request_hash, response_ref, status, expire_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{record.idempotencyId}, #{record.callerScope}, #{record.operationType,javaType=com.paytech.risk.domain.enums.CommandOperationType}, #{record.idempotencyKey}, #{record.requestHash}, NULL, #{record.status,javaType=com.paytech.risk.domain.enums.CommandIdempotencyStatus}, #{record.expireTime,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{record.createTime,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{record.updateTime,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE idempotency_id = idempotency_id
